name: kajicode-harness-behavior
description: Local fixture suite for prompt, mode, agent, and verification harness behavior.

tasks.name: Lock spec-draft readonly contract
tasks.description: Regression task for planning mode tool visibility and mutation denial.
tasks.prompt: Add focused local tests proving spec-draft mode advertises only read-only inspection tools plus submit_spec, denies write_file and bash if a model calls them anyway, and stops after submit_spec saves the review draft. Do not call a live provider.

tasks.name: Strengthen agent role catalog
tasks.description: Regression task for built-in agent role metadata and read-only navigation tools.
tasks.prompt: Add built-in agent role coverage for planner, explorer, verifier, worker, and code-review. Ensure read-only agents can use code-navigation and skill-loading tools without gaining write or shell authority.

tasks.name: Lock provider harness profile and context plan
tasks.description: Regression task for provider/model-specific prompt guidance, shared context budgeting, and weak-model tool-name repair.
tasks.prompt: Add focused local tests proving the agent maps OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Qwen, Kimi, DeepSeek, MiniMax, GLM, and generic OpenAI-compatible models to harness profiles; injects the active profile into the system prompt; counts tool schemas in the context plan before compaction; and repairs common weak-model tool aliases before replay. Do not call a live provider.
